text:
zoe-docs: Quick sync — opened PR to rework the "overage alerts" section in billing+dashboard docs. Customers were confused when alerts show estimated vs invoiced amounts.
alvin-eng: Good call. Can you paste the alert screenshot diff? We changed the alert payload to include `estimated` vs `finalized` fields last month.
zoe-docs: Updated screenshot uses `alert_type: overage_estimate` and shows the hover text that explains "estimated = based on sampled telemetry; final billed amount uses unsampled billing export." Also added tiny Ruby SDK snippet to show how to consume billing export for reconciliation.
mika-product: Love the reconciliation example. Marketing asked to show a short note about rate-limit vs quota mentions in the alert copy. Some customers read "quota" and assume request-level blocking.
zoe-docs: Added a short line: "Note: Alerts reference your monthly quota (token cap). Rate limits are separate and enforced in real-time." Also added link to rate-limits doc.
alvin-eng: Quick review of Ruby snippet  using export field names `account_id`, `period_start`, `charged_tokens`, `invoice_amount_usd` is correct. Add fallback for `invoice_amount_usd` missing for in-progress periods.
zoe-docs: Done  added fallback comment and a tiny example showing how to diff estimated vs finalized in code.
chris-sre: One telemetry caveat: when requests are routed through Reserved bursts we tag them `capacity=dedicated_pool`; billing exports use `billing_profile` to map to enterprise pricing. Recommend adding a single line mapping: capacity tag -> billing_profile.
zoe-docs: Added mapping paragraph and a short JSON snippet showing mapping rules. Also updated the dashboard sample query to use `billing_profile` and `period_start` filter.
merge-bot: PR 4799 by zoe-docs merged into docs-main  build succeeded.
zoe-docs: Thanks! I'll open a follow-up PR to add e2e snippet tests for the Ruby example and a tiny change log entry noting the alert semantics change.
